notes.title: v2 Update: New Camera, New Feel, Same Adrenaline
notes.notes:
The exciting v2 update for Dirt Bike Racer Simulator has been released! With this major update, many improvements have been made both technically and visually. Now riding a motorcycle is not just a task, but also a visual feast.

Update Details
[list]
[*] The camera system has been renewed: Players can now zoom in and out while driving. This offers a more personal and controllable camera experience.
[*] Optimized textures, improved graphic quality: The overall visual quality of the game has been increased. Higher performance and clearer images are obtained on both high and low systems.
[*] Added How to Play area: A guide panel has been added for new players. All controls have become more understandable.
[*] Fixed language errors: Spelling and character errors seen in some languages have been fixed. A more accurate multilingual experience is now offered.
[*] Added UI close and photo mode feature with F1 key: Players can close the in-game interface with F1 key and take realistic and clean screenshots.
[*] General bug fixes: Based on your feedback, many background errors have been fixed for the game to work more stably.
[/list]
